## Navigation Lights

## Standards for controls

There are two systems used in the workshop: Option A:

- WS Pitch
- AD Roll
- ↑ ↓ Throttle/Speed/Collective
- ← → Yaw

Option B:

- WS Throttle/Speed/Collective
- AD Yaw
- ↑ ↓ Pitch
- ← → Roll

Please add a toggle button to your vehicle that switches betwen those two modes (using numeric switchboxes). Set the default mode to whatever you prefer.

## Standards for lights

This is the essence from worldwide standards: [![Aircraft Navigation Lights](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/9/93/Aircraft_Navigation_Lights.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20190514102904)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/9/93/Aircraft_Navigation_Lights.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190514102904) [![Helicopter Navigation Lights](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/89/Helicopter_Navigation_Lights.jpg/revision/latest/scale-to-width-down/180?cb=20190514112534)](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/stormworks_gamepedia_en/images/8/89/Helicopter_Navigation_Lights.jpg/revision/latest?cb=20190514112534) You can find more detailed information on [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Navigation_light#Aviation_navigation_lights).
